findings.title: Pod's claim cannot be made from its template
findings.cause: the claim for the pod's resourceClaims entry gpu cannot be made from ResourceClaimTemplate one-gpu: ResourceQuota dra-claims allows no more ResourceClaims in the namespace, so the claim is refused and the scheduler waits for it; Deployment trainer has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.detail: (combined from similar events): PodResourceClaim gpu: create ResourceClaim : resourceclaims.resource.k8s.io "trainer-7845ff4f5b-h7h9q-gpu-6dv62" is forbidden: exceeded quota: dra-claims, requested: count/resourceclaims.resource.k8s.io=1, used: count/resourceclaims.resource.k8s.io=0, limited: count/resourceclaims.resource.k8s.io=0

findings.fix: Raise ResourceQuota dra-claims's count/resourceclaims.resource.k8s.io (or its device class's requests), or delete claims nothing uses any more; each pod of a template makes a claim of its own.
